scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e CI -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx playwright test
scripts.test:update-ci: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e CI=true -v $(pwd):/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble bash -c 'npm ci && npx playwright test --update-snapshots'
scripts.version: npm run build && node scripts/sync-version.js && git add dist/ README.md
